# HYBENT

> HYBENT (hybent.com) is an AI-powered software company from Ahmedabad, India. It builds intelligent software products that simplify business operations using AI. Its first product, Hybent Hiring, is an AI recruitment platform that is live in production today.

HYBENT is written in capitals in copy; "Hybent" is the same company.

## Hybent Hiring (AI recruitment platform)

- Holds the whole hiring pipeline in one place: AI resume parsing, AI screening, AI match scoring, pipeline and interview scheduling, interview management, a Recruiter Copilot, a candidate portal and hiring analytics.
- AI works inside the workflow (parse, screen, rank, draft) and every AI suggestion can be explained. Recruiters stay in control of every decision.
- Candidate data is never used to train models shared with other customers. Account-specific tuning is opt-in, documented and reversible.
- Data can be exported in open formats from the admin console at any time, with no fee and no notice period.
- Security: encryption, role-based access, audit logging and responsible AI controls built into the platform.
- Available to teams in any region.

### Pricing

- Every plan includes 1 admin seat, billed monthly. Recruiter seats are added separately; interviewers don't need a seat.
- Standard: $29 (₹2,799) per month, 5,000 AI credits a month. No Recruiter Copilot.
- Pro: $39 (₹3,799) per month, 10,000 AI credits a month. Everything in Standard plus the Recruiter Copilot.
- Each plan has one admin seat. Extra recruiter seats: $10 (₹999) per month, +1,000 AI credits each.
- Custom: additional seats and custom terms through the sales team.

## Use cases

- High-volume hiring: AI screening, bulk import (CSV/Excel), public apply links, automated scheduling.
- Tech and engineering hiring: Interviewer's Portal with prep kits and scorecards.
- Startups and small teams: one admin seat runs the pipeline; Pro adds the Recruiter's Copilot.
- Hiring from email and referrals: an email with several resumes attached becomes one candidate per resume.
- Candidate experience: a Candidate's Portal for applications, interviews, offers and prep.

## Company

- Headquarters: Ahmedabad, India (engineering, product and design). Distributed team on IST core hours.
- Founder: Bansi Desai. Co-Founder: Yash Desai.
- Principles: honest timelines, AI with accountability, partners not vendors.
